about: The epistola of the formulary “Saints Philip and James, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The just will stand with great constancy against those who afflicted them and who robbed them of their labors. When they see it, they will be troubled with terrible fear, and they will be amazed at the suddenness of an unexpected salvation, saying among themselves, doing penance, and sighing in anguish of spirit: These are they whom we once held as a laughingstock and as a proverb of reproach. We senseless ones used to count their life as madness, and their end as dishonorable. Behold how they are reckoned among the children of God, and among the saints is their lot.
